title: Coherence of adjunction composition comparisons with isomorphic right composites
statement:
Let $\mathcal C_0,\mathcal C_1,\mathcal C_2,\mathcal C_3$ be categories. For each $0\leq i<j\leq3$ fix an adjunction $L_{ij}:\mathcal C_i\rightleftarrows\mathcal C_j:R_{ji}$ with unit $\eta_{ij}$. For each $i<j<k$ fix a natural isomorphism $d_{ijk}:R_{ki}\xrightarrow{\sim}R_{ji}R_{kj}$. Suppose that for every $N\in\mathcal C_3$,
$$R_{10}(d_{123,N})\circ d_{013,N}=d_{012,R_{32}N}\circ d_{023,N}:R_{30}N\longrightarrow R_{10}R_{21}R_{32}N,$$
with canonical functor associators understood. Let $a_{ijk}:L_{jk}L_{ij}\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{ik}$ be the unique unit-compatible comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] for the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]; explicitly,
$$R_{ji}R_{kj}(a_{ijk,M})\circ R_{ji}(\eta_{jk,L_{ij}M})\circ\eta_{ij,M}=d_{ijk,L_{ik}M}\circ\eta_{ik,M}.$$
Then for every $M\in\mathcal C_0$,
$$a_{023,M}\circ L_{23}(a_{012,M})=a_{013,M}\circ a_{123,L_{01}M}:L_{23}L_{12}L_{01}M\longrightarrow L_{03}M,$$
after the canonical functor associator. The $d_{ijk}$ need not be identity maps and the composite right adjoints need not be equal as functors.
